checks: Opening the Excalidraw row captures one real public invocation and its owned checkpoint
A real Claude MCP update adds Done to the same diagram while preserving manual edits and typing
The remounted guest cannot read an older checkpoint through its current view bridge
A subsequent read-only Claude reply sees the actual agent-updated checkpoint and the manual note
Revoking the update checkbox while a reply is pending keeps the captured fork out of the view
A newer manual edit defeats a stale agent result without replaying the accepted call
A second chat attaches the updated diagram explicitly with an independent draft and update permission
Reload discards the diagram and temporary chats without rerunning create_view
